entries.11e9c44249240cca: Tenants of the commercial building 'Shinjuku Nakamuraya Building'
entries.225a8cd3d2848838: A company that carries out a confectionery business of Japanese and Western sweets and Chinese steamed buns, a food business of retort foods and restaurants, and leasing of commercial buildings.
entries.6b78ebfea8a62b44: Operators in the takeout and home-meal sector
entries.7b30246ff89c35b4: Department stores and other sales outlets
entries.7bf92ae3f96592d8: This business leases commercial buildings and land. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥912 million. In addition to leasing the commercial building 'Shinjuku Nakamuraya Building', it earns rent income from land, including part of the Musashi Plant site and the former Tokyo office site.
entries.98ba75dd0d476418: This business manufactures and sells food ingredients for business use, packaged food products for retail, and canned prepared foods, and also operates restaurants. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥10,218 million. It handles retail food products such as retort curry and Chinese cooking sauces, and food products for business use, and also operates a restaurant at the Shinjuku Nakamuraya Honten.
entries.d15b89f94cbd032d: A food manufacturer headquartered in Shinjuku Ward, Tokyo, which does not prepare consolidated financial statements and conducts its business through the company alone. It has affiliates, including TNH（HK）Holding Co.,Ltd. in Hong Kong (ownership of voting rights 30%, as of March 31, 2026). There are three reportable segments: the Confectionery Business, the Food Business and the Real Estate Leasing Business, and the number of employees in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 780.
entries.d4ea423f5dbedc28: Restaurant operators such as café chains
entries.eec4f32a7c9f2736: This business manufactures and sells Japanese confectionery, Western confectionery and Chinese steamed buns. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥26,219 million. Confectionery is manufactured at the Kanagawa Plant, Saitama Plant, Tsukuba Plant and Musashi Plant, among others, and is also sold at the Shinjuku Nakamuraya Honten store and at events.
